question: Should this PR merge with `legacy_rollback_available: false`, using the already deployed SQL-aware revision—not the pre-migration worker—as the rollback target?
rationale: The implementation and live migration are healthy, but the real active receipt set exceeds the compatibility-shadow bound; only a maintainer can accept and own the resulting rollout constraint.

options.title: Accept SQL-aware rollback only
options.body: Keep the exact-head deployment, verify continued queue completion, and merge while explicitly retaining this SQL-aware revision as the rollback target.

options.title: Restore old-worker compatibility
options.body: Revise the bridge or rollout plan so the complete active queue and dedupe state remains readable by the pre-migration worker before merge.

options.title: Pause without old-worker rollback
options.body: Hold the merge and avoid reverting until maintainers define another state-preserving recovery path.

recommendation.title: Accept SQL-aware rollback only
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-head deployment, verify continued queue completion, and merge while explicitly retaining this SQL-aware revision as the rollback target.

likelyOwner.reason: He is connected to the emergency mitigation and current deployment and is the best available owner for accepting the constrained rollout plan.
